text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a non-review research study with explicit national-scale spatial implementation—China (mainland)—as stated in the abstract and methods. The primary objective is the spatial optimization of urban land and cropland using the LANDSCAPE model to project 2030 land use under multiple scenarios (BAU, CO, OO, OCO), fulfilling the requirement of ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison. The modeling is spatially explicit at 1 km resolution, includes mapped LULC projections (e.g., Figs. 2–4, Fig. 3), and reports quantitative accuracy metrics (Kappa Simulation scores in Table 2). Although ecological impacts are assessed, the core focus is on optimizing and predicting LULC change based on agricultural production capacity, meeting all core inclusion criteria and avoiding all exclusion criteria.)
